metadata.mechanics:
At the end of Active Role-play all, 5 participants must inflict 5 Body damage to themselves to complete the Benediction. Upon completion of the Benediction of the Wailing Abyss, the Consecrated Area also functions as a Morgue space for the next 4 hours. If the Benediction of the Wailing Abyss is performed by a Life Anchor or Saint they may spend 1 Resolve at completion of the Benediction to extend the effects until the end of the event.

The leader of the Benediction must be of the same Faith as the Consecrated ground being used. If any of those participating are not of the same Faith, they need to sacrifice 20 Body instead of 5 and additionally expend 1 Resolve.
metadata.notes: This space must be decorated appropriately and requires Director approval.
metadata.requirementsToUse: Lore: Faith - Common OR Any Basic Faithful Development skill. User must be Inducted to a canon faith.
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: 5 participants must engage in a ritual relating to faith and death while adorning the Consecrated Space with artifacts relating to both faith and death. Items should be kept to genre and provide clear reference that dominates the role-play space. Ritual role-play should include wound infliction to represent the 5 Body damage.
